tagline: Aspen country above Zion’s red and white rock.
intro: From Highway 14 east of Cedar City, the backway passes through thick aspen forest toward Kolob Reservoir. Grassy meadows follow, then the red and white backcountry of Zion on the way to Highway 9 at Virgin. The drive comes down from mountain water to red rock.
The reservoir was made for flood control and irrigation storage by a dam built by two canal companies. From December to May snow covers the roads, and the lake is reached only by snowmobile.

moments.title: Kolob Reservoir
moments.text: Fences mark where private grazing land begins on almost every shore, so camping keeps close to the water.

moments.title: Virgin
moments.text: At 3,606 feet, Virgin, named for the river beside it and first settled in 1858, is where the backway meets Highway 9.

practical: The backway closes in winter and is unsuitable for travel in wet conditions.
